- Experience is not required, but is a plus

- Physically fit and proactive

- Communicates respectfully and inspires team engagement
- Automation experience is highly desirable
- Able to work independently and motivate colleagues
- Physically fit and comfortable with active work
- Speaks Dutch or English
- Flexible and solution-oriented mindset
